an4.259:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgan t' eva, saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.259:1.3: Idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājānīyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti, balasampanno ca javasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.259:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro . . . aṅgan t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.259:2.1: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an4.259:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti, balasampanno ca, javasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.259:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti?
an4.259:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an4.259:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an4.259:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti?
an4.259:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āradhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an4.259:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balavasampanno hoti.
an4.259:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti?
an4.259:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.259:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an4.259:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti?
an4.259:6.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti.
an4.259:7.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave bhikkhu catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti. 257.1 1.
